mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product ( category_id, name, author, publisher, price, stock_quantity, description, status, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{categoryId}, #{name}, #{author}, #{publisher}, #{price}, #{stockQuantity}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )

INSERT INTO product_image ( product_id, original_file_name, stored_file_name, image_path, image_type, sort_order ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{originalFileName}, #{storedFileName}, #{imagePath}, #{imageType}, #{sortOrder} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, c.category_name, p.name, p.author, p.publisher, p.price, p.stock_quantity, p.description, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.product_id = #{productId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT product_image_id, image_path, image_type, sort_order FROM product_image WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC

SELECT product_id, category_id, name, author, publisher, price, stock_quantity, description, status, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM product WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET category_id = #{categoryId}, name = #{name}, author = #{author}, publisher = #{publisher}, price = #{price}, stock_quantity = #{stockQuantity}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE product_id = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT product_image_id, product_id, original_file_name, stored_file_name, image_path, image_type, sort_order, created_at FROM product_image WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND image_type = 'THUMBNAIL' LIMIT 1

SELECT product_image_id, product_id, original_file_name, stored_file_name, image_path, image_type, sort_order, created_at FROM product_image WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND image_type = #{imageType} ORDER BY sort_order ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM product_image WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND image_type = 'THUMBNAIL'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'SOLD_OUT'
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW(), deleted_at = NOW() WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id, p.name, p.author, p.publisher, p.price, p.stock_quantity, pi.image_path FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_image pi ON p.product_id = pi.product_id AND pi.image_type = 'THUMBNAIL' WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 4

SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, c.category_name, p.name, p.author, p.publisher, p.price, p.stock_quantity, p.description, p.status FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.product_id = #{productId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
